honesty: Predictions come only from Uberon taxon constraints, so they are the same for every species inside the same constrained clade. Differences between bird species cannot appear unless Uberon states them.
A "default" presence is not a claim that the species has the structure; it says the ontology does not rule it out. The scorer may treat default and stated differently.
The panel is whatever Uberon constrains, not a list chosen by the builder.
